name: PikuDAO USP
oneLiner: USP is PikuDAO's NAV-appreciating yield-fund token backed by Turkey-FX delta-neutral arbitrage, DeFi allocations, and a stablecoin buffer, KYC-gated.
collateral: Diversified basket of off-chain and on-chain yield strategies: BMMF Turkey FX arbitrage (delta-neutral), DeFi protocol allocations (Ethena, Aave, Cap, Giza, Almanak, USD.AI), and cash stablecoins (USDC/USDT) as a buffer; allocation governed by PikuDAO
pegMechanism: NAV-based strategy-fund share; redemptions use a FIFO smart-contract queue with a published 0.2% fee and KYC/KYB requirements. The current vault page states a two-day processing target, but governing Terms permit discretionary delays and do not guarantee completed payout within that period.
